_what: Phase H: pretrained BST against hand-labelled contacts. No training, no fine-tuning, no threshold fitting.
uncertain_note: Contacts the labeller marked uncertain rather than guessing. They are recorded in the truth file and left out of scoring, so they neither flatter nor penalise the model.
serve_note: Serve is the first contact of a rally and derivable from rally structure, so it is scored separately rather than counted as evidence the visual classifier works.
baseline_note: Phase J: hand-written badminton geometry, no learning. Its top-2 column is meaningless -- the rules make one hard decision -- and is reported only so the table lines up.
